audits.purpose: Use structured target-year tables rather than flattened dual-year lines to eliminate broad-gas false positives and close residual scopes across ten previously retained facilities.
audits.riverside_integrity: Carbon monoxide 126,137 kg seen in a dual-year presentation is not present in the structured 2024 PI table and is not promoted.
audits.beddington_integrity: Nitrous oxide 16,524 kg seen as a single-value dual-year line is absent from the structured 2024 PI table; 2024/2025 APR trend is consistent with later-year placement, but APR is not used as PI evidence.
audits.apr_policy: APR N2O values for Ferrybridge 2, Severnside and Battlefield are not substituted for absent PI substance rows.
audits.prior_blob_policy: Previously retained Part84-Part115 rows are reconciled against authoritative report blobs; repository search indexing is secondary and not used as the uniqueness authority.
audits.direct_raw_policy: Official PI lineage remains verified but no direct official facility row is consumed; confidence policy is unchanged.
audits.zero_policy: Absent, ambiguous and later-year values remain no-data and are never converted to zero.
